title: Comparison of even binomial coefficients
statement: Let $p,q,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<q$, $q<p$, $p<1$, $0\leq\rho$, and $\rho^2=(1-p)/(1-q)$. For every natural number $k\geq1$, the generalized binomial coefficients satisfy $\binom{p}{2k}\leq(p/q)\binom{q}{2k}\rho^{2k}$.
hypotheses_covered: Real numbers p, q, and rho
replaced: Let $0<q<p<1$, $\rho\ge0$, and $\rho^2=(1-p)/(1-q)$. For every integer $k\ge1$, $\binom p{2k}\le(p/q)\binom q{2k}\rho^{2k}$, with generalized binomial coefficients.
